name: @jetserge/next-prompt
description: pi and Oh My Pi (OMP) coding-agent extension that suggests the next logical prompt after an agent turn settles (inline ghost, below-editor widget, or both).

scripts.verify:package: npm pack --dry-run --json | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const d=JSON.parse(s);const pkg=Object.values(d)[0];const got=pkg.files.map(f=>f.path).sort();const want=["LICENSE","README.md","next-prompt.ts","package.json"].sort();if(JSON.stringify(got)!==JSON.stringify(want)){console.error("package contents mismatch: got "+JSON.stringify(got)+" want "+JSON.stringify(want));process.exit(1)}console.log("package contents exact: "+got.join(", "))})'
